name: InfoTracer

steps.text: Find your own record in the results (check the age, city and relatives), select it, and finish the site's steps. Then press "I've done this step".

notes: The site searches by name and state, then a person selects their record and uses "Remove Data", which ends with a slider check. privacy@infopay.com takes requests if the form fails.
source: Process per redact.dev's InfoTracer removal guide (updated 2026-08-11).
